source.author: ov
source.text: Atque ita terrigenis rigido de fratribus unum comminus ense ferit; iaculo cadit eminus ipse.
source.text_original: Atque ita terrigenis rigido de fratribus unum / comminus ense ferit; iaculo cadit eminus ipse.
source.text_english: And so he strikes one of the earth-born brothers at close range with his hard sword; he himself falls from afar, struck by a spear.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Whom does he strike with his sword?
